troubleshooting_steps: Management IP 172.20.20.16 did not respond to ICMP.
Management-plane SSH connection failed: timed out
Verify that the device is powered on and the network OS is running.
Verify management network connectivity to the device.
Verify the management interface IP address and gateway.
Verify that the SSH service is running and reachable.
Check device or container logs for startup or service failures.
remediation_actions: Automatic configuration recovery could not be performed because the device was unreachable through SSH.
Automatic device/container restart was not performed because power or container recovery is outside the approved self-healing scope.
